framepatch. Made for your next edit.
What does the patch do?

Moves the movie index to the front, removes global export metadata, and optionally applies the unspecified-duration header observed in the supplied sample. Encoded video and audio are copied unchanged. Platform compression results vary; improved TikTok upload quality has not been verified. Standard, self-contained MP4/MOV files are supported. Fragmented files are not.
